services.title: *Services* for better products
services.tagline: Six disciplines, one accountable partner — from rough idea to a product people actually use.

audience.label: Who I build for
audience.textA: From established companies to first-time founders, I hold the same standard for both.
audience.textB: Products that launch fast, fit the need and scale easily.

items.title: UI design
items.text: Consistent web and app interfaces, ready for development.
items.long: The interface is where your product meets people. I design clear, consistent screens that are ready for development, so engineers never have to guess.

items.title: Research & UX
items.text: Interviews, user flows and data-backed wireframes.
items.long: Before drawing, I ask. Interviews, real behavior and user flows make sure every decision has a reason.

items.title: Design system
items.text: A component kit that keeps the team fast and aligned.
items.long: One shared component kit keeps the team fast and the product consistent as it grows.

items.title: Project management
items.text: Planning, progress tracking and on-time delivery.
items.long: I keep projects on track: clear tasks, owners and deadlines, with early warnings when risk shows up.

items.title: Consulting & sales
items.text: From quoting and closing scripts to after-sales care.
items.long: Good design also has to sell. I support you from quoting and closing scripts to after-sales care.

items.title: Essential branding
items.text: Logo, color and a lean identity for a new brand.
items.long: A lean identity is enough to make a new brand look trustworthy from day one.

services.h1: Strategy, design, and execution. *Without the agency overhead.*
services.lead: Six disciplines, one accountable partner. I work with founders and scaling teams who need quality output at start-up speed — using AI to cut timelines without cutting corners on craft.
services.principlesTitle: After 5+ years and many shipped products, *a few things have become non-negotiable*

principles.title: Product focus
principles.text: A beautiful interface nobody understands is a failure. Every decision starts with the product and its users.

principles.title: Co-founder mentality
principles.text: I care about the outcome like an insider: I’ll say so when a direction looks off, before you ship.

principles.title: Proven delivery
principles.text: Years of shipping for start-ups and enterprises alike. The process is battle-tested, so the work lands on time and holds up in production.

principles.title: Start-up pace
principles.text: Test early, fix early, hand off clean. AI shortens the timeline without cutting corners on craft.

about.lead: I’ve been building digital products for years, back when “AI” meant autocorrect. Now I use it to deliver for founders and businesses in days what agencies quote in months.

fast.title: Fast, focused, *AI-native*
text: Product design is about solving the right problem, then executing it without ceremony.

I work with early-stage companies and scaling teams that need decisions made, not workshopped. My process is built around fast delivery, from strategy to handoff, without the two-week kick-off theater.
I’ve shipped products across SaaS, fintech and consumer apps. The tools have changed. The discipline hasn’t.

tools.title: Tools stack *powering my work*
tools.text: My work runs on a diverse stack of tools ranging from design systems and collaboration to automation and AI. They help me work smarter, scale faster and go beyond expectations. The stack is always evolving.

principles.title: Different isn’t a promise. *Here’s what it actually means*

items.title: No theater.
items.text: No decks that never ship. Every deliverable has a job — if it doesn’t, it doesn’t get made.

items.title: No black holes.
items.text: You’ll always know where we are, what’s blocked, and what I actually think — including when I think we’re solving the wrong problem.

items.title: AI in the room.
items.text: I use AI across the entire process — faster research, validation and prototypes. The craft stays human.

items.title: I’ll tell you when it’s wrong.
items.text: If something’s off — structurally, strategically, visually — I’ll say so before you ship it, not after.

items.title: Skin in the game.
items.text: Your runway is real. I work with the urgency of someone who cares whether this succeeds.

items.title: You talk to me.
items.text: No account managers. No relays. You work directly with the person doing the work.
